# Custom Cursor

> A browser extension and Windows app platform for personalizing web cursors with themed collections, character packs, and user-created designs.

Custom Cursor offers a curated library of cursor packs spanning anime, gaming, cute characters, and pop culture themes. The platform supports Chrome, Windows 10, and multiple languages, with both pre-made collections and user uploads enabling extensive cursor customization.

## Getting Started

- [Custom Cursor](https://custom-cursor.com/en): Browser extension homepage for customizing cursors with collections and uploads
- [How to use Custom Cursor on Chrome](https://custom-cursor.com/en//how-to-use/chrome): Installation and usage guide for Custom Cursor on Chrome browser
- [How to use Custom Cursor for Windows 10 app](https://custom-cursor.com/en/how-to-use/windows): Setup and usage instructions for Custom Cursor Windows 10 app
- [Custom Cursor Unblocked](https://custom-cursor.com/en/custom-cursor-unblocked): Troubleshooting guide for accessing Custom Cursor when blocked

## Cursor Collections & Packs

- [Cursor Collections](https://custom-cursor.com/en/collections): Browse themed cursor collections including anime, gaming, and movie cursors
- [Top Cursor Packs](https://custom-cursor.com/en/tops): Most popular and installed cursor packs based on user choices
- [Editors Picks](https://custom-cursor.com/en/editors_picks): Curated cursor pack combinations and themed collections by editors
- [New Cursor Packs](https://custom-cursor.com/en/packs): Recently added cursor packs including anime and gaming themed cursors
